regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation: only 6 of 16 themes are trend-gate eligible, led by Oil & Gas Producers (crowded, high score but mixed Hurst) ahead of Big Banks (trend Hurst, uncrowded). The validated edge here is only the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control, not any return forecast; rank-IC is ~0 and rotation timing is display-only, so this is a discipline lens, not a prediction engine.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Big Banks (ZEB.TO) can narrow the leadership margin against Oil & Gas Producers: I retire this watch if the gap between XEG.TO and ZEB.TO 20-day returns widens by more than 3 percentage points from today, confirming energy retains the crown and no confirmed handoff is forming.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Energy is the dominant narrative with the highest score and full breadth, and it remains trend-gate eligible. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg here and it is helping (gate_helps=true), so I favor maintaining participation in the leading theme rather than avoiding it—but the mixed Hurst tag and crowded flag argue for a modest lean, not conviction.
evidence: crowded=true with crowding_z=1.3 (size-down caution, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Crowding at 1.3z plus unscheduled_share=1.0 in the macro backdrop suggests headline-driven volatility; a crude price shock could unwind leadership quickly, and the mixed Hurst tag implies the trend is not cleanly persistent.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags ZEB.TO by more than 5% on a total-return basis before the 20-day check

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the closest eligible challenger (rank 2) with a genuine trend Hurst tag and are not crowded; they screen as the cleanest trend-following candidate under the validated absolute-trend discipline, and rotation shows a confirmed challenger structure rather than a next-theme guess.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.43, meaning the rally is narrow within the theme; if a handful of large banks stop contributing, the theme-level trend can stall without the rest of the sector confirming.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO prints a lower 20-day total return than XEG.TO and XST.TO both

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: REITs are non-eligible (bottom of ranks at -0.92) and show a trend Hurst tag but no positive score; under the trend-gate discipline there is no basis to overweight a theme that has not cleared the eligibility gate, regardless of the rate narrative.
evidence: gate_helps=true (gate discipline favors staying out of non-eligible themes)
theses.dissent: If the inflation/growth macro backdrop (tracked in macro_narrative) turns decisively toward falling rates, REITs could mean-revert sharply and the trend gate would have been too slow to capture the move.

falsifier.text: XRE.TO rises more than 6% over 20 days while rank-eligible XIT.TO is flat or negative

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
